title: BA1/124/2005 of RAJU@  RAJENDRA SINGH Vs STATE

paras.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARANCHAL AT NAINITAL
ORIGINAL JURISDICTION
Dated: Nainital: the 15th day of February, 2005
Bail application No. 124 of 2005
Order on the Bail Application of accused
CRIMINAL SIDE
Raju @ Rajendra Singh
S/o Hari Singh Jyala
R/o Village - Chandpur
Police Station - Khatima
District - Udham Singh Nagar ...... Applicant
Versus
 State of Uttaranchal ........ Opposite Party
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Arising out of case crime No. 725 of 2004
U/S 302 I.P.C., 3(2) V.S.C. & S.T. Act
Police Station - Khatima
District - Udham Singh Nagar
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Hon'ble B.C. Kandpal, J.
The applicant has applied for bail in case crime no. 725 of 2004, U/S
302 I.P.C., 3(2) V S.C. & S.T. Act, Police Station - Khatima, District -
Udham Singh Nagar.
Heard Sri R.S. Sammal, learned counsel for the applicant, learned
A.G.A. and perused the record.
The applicant has been assigned the role of causing injuries with a
sharp-edged weapon, but the postmortem report of the deceased Chheda
Singh shows that he sustained all lacerated wounds on his person.
Considering the aforesaid circumstances, I think it would be just and
proper to releas applicant on bail at this stage.
Let the applicant, Raju @ Rajendra Singh be released on bail on
executing a personal bond and furnishing two sureties each in the like amount
to the satisfaction of C.J.M. concerned.
